featured_reviews.name: Fatima Attari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disappointed with The Cat King.

I had booked a grooming appointment for my cat and paid a 100 booking fee in advance. Unfortunately, my cat fell ill on the day of the appointment and I had to rush to the vet. I even had a valid doctor’s prescription and was ready to share proof, yet the staff refused to either refund or even reschedule the appointment. The complete lack of empathy towards a sick pet was honestly shocking.

On top of that, booking appointments with them is unnecessarily difficult. They are extremely rigid with timings and never make any effort to accommodate customer preferences or help find suitable slots. It always feels like customers are expected to adjust entirely according to their convenience, with zero flexibility from their side.

For a business dealing with pets and pet parents, basic understanding and customer service should be expected — sadly, that is completely missing here. Definitely not an experience I would recommend.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi; we truly regret to hear that your pet was unwell and we hope your pet recover soon 🩶

•Your appointment was confirmed and reserved for your pets
•Around 2 hrs of grooming time was blocked for that day and no other appointments was accepted in that slot.

•we always try to provide best service and because of that ; our available slot are limited; and not easily replaceable at 
short notice.
•At the times of booking ; it was inform in advance that the booking amount is non refundable  and non transferable in case of cancellation ; no show or same- day changes .
•once the slot unused its affect schedule and staff availability of that day.
•This policy is kept the same for all customers to maintain  fairness and smooth service.
•we completely understand your situation & regret you pet was  feeling unwell but as the slot was already reserved for you and the policy was inform prior to booking we are unable to refund or transfer the booking amount of ₹100.
Thanks you for your understanding  and support.

featured_reviews.name: Tirth Mistry
featured_reviews.review_text:
31st March 2025
Very cheap quality product.

This is a honest review and it’s not written after having any heated discussions with the store.

I recommend that if you’re buying pay a little extra and buy from reputable stores.

Their products are very old and are eating dust on the racks.
I purchased a squeaky toy today which stopped working as soon as I removed it from the packaging, even before my dog could sniff it.

They don’t take any responsibility of the product once you step out of the store.
Hence I recommend buyers to invest in a more reputable and reliable chains like Heads up for tails.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Tirth,
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Kindly send us the details on this email ID: [contact@shakehands.co.in] so we can understand the issue better. Please be assured that we will thoroughly investigate the matter and revert back to you at the earliest. We truly appreciate your patience and the opportunity to make things right.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Great service! Genuine products, timely delivery, and good discounts.

However, one thing I didn’t like is the delivery charge, even for orders of ₹1000 and above. It feels like half the discount gets offset by the delivery fee. They should at least offer free delivery for orders above ₹500.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear kunal,
Thank you for your feedback! We’re glad to hear you’re happy with our products and services. We truly value your input and will take your suggestion about delivery charges into consideration as we continue to improve. Your support means a lot to us!
